original.statement: The ingress-shim component adds a new command-line flag --extra-certificate-annotations that allows specifying annotation keys to be copied from Ingress-like resources to resulting Certificate objects.

decision.reason: [ev-dde3ce032096] says "Added ingress-shim option `--extra-certificate-annotations`". That supports a cli-flag subject spelled `--extra-certificate-annotations`. The text names ingress-shim as the part of cert-manager that owns the option, so component=ingress-shim is justified. The change type is "added". The render validators were inconclusive (the flag is not visible with chart defaults), so they do not contradict this.
